description_en: Queries the SSL client certificates that have been created
description_zh: 调用DescribeSslVpnClientCerts接口查询已创建的SSL客户端证书
kebab_example: aliyun vpc describe-ssl-vpn-client-certs --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ssl-vpn-server-id vss-bp18q7hzj6largv4v0000 --ssl-vpn-client-cert-id vsc-bp1n8wcf134yl0osr0000 --name cert1 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --resource-group-id rg-acfmzs372yg0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSslVpnClientCerts

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the SSL client certificates that you want to query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的SSL客户端证书所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SSL server
parameters.name: ssl_vpn_server_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SSL client certificate
parameters.name: ssl_vpn_client_cert_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the SSL client certificate
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The page number of the list. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for paging. Default value: 10. Valid values: 1 to 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页显示的条目数。默认值：10，取值范围：1~50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the SSL client certificate belongs.

The SSL client certificate belongs to the same resource group as its associated SSL server. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2794078.html operation to query the resource group ID of the SSL server
parameters.help_zh:
SSL客户端证书所属的资源组ID。

SSL客户端证书与其关联的SSL服务端的资源组相同。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2794078.html接口查询SSL服务端所属的资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the list

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page for paging
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页显示的条目数

SslVpnClientCertKey.description_en: The list of SSL client certificates
SslVpnClientCertKey.description_zh: SSL客户端证书的信息列表

items.description_en: The information about the SSL client certificate

CreateTime.description_en:
The creation timestamp of the SSL client certificate. Unit: milliseconds.

The timestamp follows the UNIX timestamp format, which represents the total number of milliseconds elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC to the creation time of the SSL client certificate
CreateTime.description_zh:
SSL客户端证书的创建时间戳。单位：毫秒。

时间戳的格式采用Unix时间戳，表示从格林威治时间1970年01月01日00时00分00秒至创建SSL客户端证书时的总时长

EndTime.description_en:
The expiration timestamp of the SSL client certificate. Unit: milliseconds.

The timestamp follows the UNIX timestamp format, which represents the total number of milliseconds elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC to the expiration time of the SSL client certificate
EndTime.description_zh:
SSL客户端证书的到期时间戳。单位：毫秒。

时间戳的格式采用Unix时间戳，表示从格林威治时间1970年01月01日00时00分00秒至SSL客户端证书到期时的总时长

Name.description_en: The name of the SSL client certificate

RegionId.description_en: The region of the SSL client certificate

ResourceGroupId.description_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the SSL client certificate belongs.

You can call the [ListResourceGroups]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158855.html） operation to query resource group information
ResourceGroupId.description_zh:
SSL客户端证书所属的资源组ID。

您可以调用[ListResourceGroups]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158855.html）接口查询资源组信息

SslVpnClientCertId.description_en: The ID of the SSL client certificate

SslVpnServerId.description_en: The ID of the SSL server

Status.description_en:
The status of the client certificate.

expiring-soon: The certificate will expire within one week.
   
normal: Normal.   

expired: Expired
Status.description_zh:
客户端证书的状态。

expiring-soon：证书将在1周后过期。
   
normal：正常。   

expired：已过期。
